intro: Every tattoo is custom, so booking starts with a conversation, not a calendar.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.description: Tell us about your idea, placement, and size, and choose an artist.

steps.title: Your artist reviews it
steps.description: They make sure it's a good fit and estimate how long it will take.

steps.title: Schedule and deposit
steps.description: Your artist contacts you to pick a date and take a deposit to hold your spot.

whyRequest: Custom work can take anywhere from one hour to several sessions. Reviewing your idea first lets your artist give you an accurate time and price, instead of guessing.
disclaimer: Your artist may ask for more details or an in-person consultation before scheduling your appointment.
